hypothesis: Sufficiency-then-compression recovers the ground-truth invariant where description-length minimization collapses the obstruction and accuracy maximization never compresses.

controls.description: A pure description-length-minimizing selector, which should collapse the obstruction.
A pure mutual-information-maximizing selector, which should never compress.
All 2**n worlds and all lattice quotients are enumerated, so metrics carry no sampling error.

gates.criterion: Sufficient-then-compress recovers the exact invariant in every task.
Description-length minimization always selects an insufficient quotient.
Mutual-information maximization always selects the identity.
The minimal-sufficient quotient is strictly more compressed than the accuracy-only choice.
